# Identify years that appear in the 'Year' column
years_with_films = df['Year'].dropna().astype(int).unique()

# Determine the range of years that might be considered (from min to max year in the data)
min_year = int(df['Year'].min())
max_year = int(df['Year'].max())

# Generate a list of all integer years in that range
all_years_in_range = list(range(min_year, max_year + 1))

# Find years in the range that are not present in the data
years_without_films = [year for year in all_years_in_range if year not in years_with_films]

# Select one such year (the first one for definiteness)
answer = years_without_films[0] if years_without_films else None
